senses.gloss: m. pl. (Ispe. noun of קרט; cmp. חָלַט I a. denom.) balls; a kind of paste. Mekh. B’shall. Vayas. 5 כעין אסקריטי (read … טין).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:4">Ḥall. I, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 37a:5">Pes. 37ᵃ</cite>. Y. Ḥall. III, 57ᵈ bot. <he>אי׳ חליטין דשוק</he> isk’ritin are &c., v. <cite ref="H01038"><he>חֲלִיטָא</he> III</cite>.
